command: unset MSYS_NO_PATHCONV; echo '== eslint'; corepack pnpm --filter @acs/web lint 2>&1 | tail -4; a=$?; echo '== typecheck'; corepack pnpm --filter @acs/web typecheck 2>&1 | tail -3; b=$?; echo '== vitest'; corepack pnpm --filter @acs/web test 2>&1 | tail -7; c=$?; echo '== widget tests'; corepack pnpm --filter @acs/widget test 2>&1 | tail -6; d=$?; echo '== format:check'; corepack pnpm format:check 2>&1 | tail -6; e=$?; echo exit lint=$a typecheck=$b web=$c widget=$d format=$e; exit $((a+b+c+d+e))
